cleanTruthBoundary: The app receives only noisy observations and application events. Clean geometry, diary positions, intended turns, noise labels, and evaluation tolerances remain outside the product boundary.

required: Mapbox walking Directions HTTP 200 with GeoJSON geometry
every returned step uses walking mode
no ferry, shuttle, cableway, or other non-pedestrian segment
route geometry is reviewed on a real Mapbox basemap
named street, park, passage, bridge, or trail provenance is recorded
realistic speed, acceleration, stop, restart, and timestamp constraints
reject: arbitrary straight line across buildings, walls, water, or inaccessible terrain
route returned only by a non-walking profile

providerBudget.note: Geocoding/style preflights are counted separately in the final usage report. Identical final requests use captured-response replay after the representative live subset.
